describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on four legs. It has a broad, flat, pale pinkish-beige head with large round eyes and moist, wrinkled skin, six feathery reddish-brown external gills protruding from the neck behind the head, and a stout quadrupedal body. Its back, sides and the base of its tail are covered in dense, overlapping large brown scales with darker edges, while its belly, neck, limbs, head and tail are pale, fleshy and deeply wrinkled with loose folds. It has four thick limbs ending in broad clawed feet and a single thick tapering tail extending to the rear left.

describe.description: A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right-side three-quarter view with a broad pale pinkish-beige amphibian-like head and soft wrinkled underside, and a high arched back completely covered in overlapping large brown scales. The head has large round eyes, small nostrils and a faint smiling mouth, with three feathery reddish-brown external gill stalks protruding from each side behind the head. It stands on four short thick wrinkled legs ending in splayed clawed feet, and a thick tapering tail extends behind to the left out of the frame.
